entries.subject: DAMIT 490: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-490.txt. Model 490, version 2013-02-11, pole (324°, 45°), period 5.582028 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA thermal scale
entries.finding: The retained AcuA row 512 (Taurinensis; seven detections) supplies a 20.87 ± 0.36 km fitted nonrotating-sphere effective diameter. The recipe transfers it uniformly to the uncalibrated DAMIT 490 mesh as an approximate volume scale. The catalog error is thermal-model/statistical only; it does not establish total size uncertainty, local shape accuracy, terrain or imagery. The retrieved original catalogue row was compared field-for-field with the retained row and matches.

entries.subject: Historical model and population records
entries.finding: Historical review retained the Hanuš et al. (2013) model-publication record and JPL SBDB Mars-crosser classification from the former README survey. They provide source context only: neither alters the only DAMIT model in the checked listing nor qualifies terrain, imagery or the AKARI scale.
